description: This file defines the class 'Statistics' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Report'. The class provides methods to interact with a 'statistics' database table, including retrieving, adding, removing, and editing statistical values used in the report module of the admin panel.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: A model class for interacting with statistical data stored in the database, used within the admin reporting module.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistical records from the database.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific statistic code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a specified value to an existing statistic identified by the code.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Subtracts a specified value from an existing statistic identified by the code.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Replaces the current value of a statistic with a new value.
